rendered_documents.body:
### Quant Workflow Readiness (simulation)

- Generated at: 2026-05-11T19:10:24.570122+08:00
- Version: v1
- Audience: trading workflow reviewer

### What this note is trying to do
- Explain the current trading evidence, assumptions, and stage gates in plain language.
- Separate research conclusions, execution suggestions, and risk prompts so the workflow remains auditable.
- Show what changed, what remains blocked, and what can be acted on next.

### Review order
- Understand the current evidence set and risk language before touching execution settings.
- Review the workflow in order: candidate preparation -> healthcheck -> candidate framework -> backtest -> readiness.
- Check the active trade universe and understand why each name remains in its current bucket.
- Verify risk budget and pause rules before any simulation or live-adjacent step.

### Workflow order
- Run the read-only health check first.
- Review research findings and evidence levels.
- Check the candidate buckets and keep only the intended trade-universe names active.
- Review one backtest or validation summary before any simulation idea.
- Move to simulation or live readiness only after risk budget and readiness checklist are both clear.

### Current assumptions
- task_type: simulation — Healthcheck and readiness evidence requirements differ for simulation and live-oriented reviews.
- preferred_markets: us — Candidate framework filtering stays aligned with the requested market subset.
- workflow_mode: balanced — Risk profile is retained as user context even though the workflow now focuses on evidence gathering instead of personal planning.

### Knowledge sections

### Research conclusions
- [mid] Readiness for task type simulation currently has 5 unmet item(s).

### Common pitfalls
- Confusing a good story with a tested rule.
- Looking only at return and ignoring drawdown, turnover, and sample quality.
- Adding too many correlated names and calling it diversification.
- Letting an LLM summary replace manual review of evidence and risk controls.
- At least one observation target must survive candidate framework filtering.
- Every promoted observation target should resolve to daily or minute cadence before readiness can pass.

### Minimum viable start
- One market, a focused trade universe, and a stable review habit.
- A written risk budget with single-position, total-exposure, and pause rules.
- At least one backtest or validation note with data-quality and cost assumptions recorded.
- A simulation observation period before any live intent.
- Use the top few priority_trade or active_watch names as the initial review universe.

### Readiness checkpoints
- Stage simulation: 5 readiness items still need work.
- candidate_targets_present [high] — At least one observation target must survive candidate framework filtering. Remediation: Refresh candidate inputs and rerun candidate framework selection.
- trading_level_assignment [high] — Every promoted observation target should resolve to daily or minute cadence before readiness can pass. Remediation: Keep cadence=needs_review symbols in observation mode until liquidity, signal, and review evidence improves.
- backtest_evidence [high] — Readiness requires at least one local historical backtest evidence record for the promoted targets. Remediation: Generate or place the required local backtest report before stage upgrade.
- optimization_evidence [medium] — Optimization evidence should be present so the workflow can track best parameters for each promoted target. Remediation: Attach a sweep or optimization artifact for every promoted symbol.
- backtest_metrics_traceable [high] — Backtest evidence should expose both sample period and performance metrics before readiness can pass. Remediation: Regenerate or standardize the local backtest reports so period and metrics are complete.

### What changed from the previous plan
- No previous plan comparison was available for this run.

### Personalization summary
- No explicit personalization summary was recorded for this artifact.

### Update scope
- No scoped profile update information was recorded.

### Next actions
- Refresh candidate inputs and rerun candidate framework selection.
- Keep cadence=needs_review symbols in observation mode until liquidity, signal, and review evidence improves.
- Generate or place the required local backtest report before stage upgrade.
- Attach a sweep or optimization artifact for every promoted symbol.
- Regenerate or standardize the local backtest reports so period and metrics are complete.
- Resolve the failed readiness items before promoting the workflow to the next stage.
- Do not upgrade stages until the failed readiness items are resolved.

### Local system boundaries
- Execution-related stages still require explicit confirmation and should default to plan-only mode.
